concerns.text: The NOAA NCEP/NCAR Global Sea‑Level Pressure dataset is accessed via the OPeNDAP endpoint but is **not listed in the Verified Datasets block**. This violates Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) which requires all external data sources to be verified. Use a pressure dataset that has an explicit verified URL (e.g., a curated subset hosted on HuggingFace) or add the NOAA endpoint to the verified list after appropriate validation.

The plan stores the raw NOAA pressure reanalysis file under `data/raw/ncep_global_pressure.nc`. The full NCEP/NCAR reanalysis archive exceeds the allocated disk quota (< 14 GB) for the free‑tier GitHub Actions runner, risking storage overflow and CI failure. Either stream the data without persisting the full file, or switch to a smaller, verified pressure subset that fits within the disk limit.
